aiOverview.content: Unified super featherweight champion Alycia Baumgardner defends her WBA, WBO, and IBF titles against Bo Mi Re Shin at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden on Friday, April 17, 2026. The bout highlights the MVPW-02 card, with Baumgardner seeking a statement win after a 2025 victory over Leila Beaudoin.Watch the official weigh-in and final face-off between Alycia Baumgardner and Bo Mi Re Shin:11:28Alycia Baumgardner vs Bo Mi Re Shin - FULL Weigh In + Final ...Fight Hub TVYouTube• Apr 16, 2026Key Fight Details:Fight Date: Friday, April 17, 2026.Location: Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, New York.Opponent: Bo Mi Re Shin (19-3-3).Titles on the Line: WBA, WBO, IBF Super Featherweight.Special Rules: The 10-round fight is set to be contested under men's rules (10x3 minute rounds).Watch Live: The main card is set for ESPN.Baumgardner (17-1, 7 KOs) last fought on December 19, 2025, winning a unanimous decision against Leila Beaudoin in Miami. Her opponent, Bo Mi Re Shin, is known for her 2025 performance against Caroline Dubois.This fight takes place following a period where Baumgardner was cleared to return to boxing in March 2024 by the Association of Boxing Commissions following a previous investigation into a positive, then negative, drug test.
